purpose: Explore real visited locations derived from completed drives, ranked by visit frequency, with dwell-time comparisons and location evidence.
primaryGoal: Understand where the selected vehicle has been during the workspace time window and inspect or navigate to related evidence without confusing loaded-page summaries with full-range totals.

dataSources.name: locationsQuery
dataSources.sourceOwnership: internal\database\trip\visited_location_repo.go derives groups from completed drives and joined geofences; geofence name precedes end_place, IDs are MIN(d.id), ordering is visit_count descending then ID.

evidence.detail: GET /locations mounted under the API router.
Parses pagination and paired RFC3339 bounds; positive vehicle IDs; empty slices normalized to [].
COUNT(*) and SUM(duration_s), MAX(ended_at), grouped before LIMIT/OFFSET; both bounds apply to ended_at.

dataSources.trust: Historical deriveDataState; fatal failures replace only data-bound content, refresh failures retain payload. Receipt freshness is not the last visit time.
dataSources.units: total_duration_s is seconds on the wire/cache; useUnits.formatDuration converts only for display. Chart hours are a display derivation.
dataSources.scope: All six summary metrics and both leaderboards use only the loaded 50-row page; search filters only those returned rows.

dataSources.name: AI auto-name draft
dataSources.owner: Shared AI component and backend auto-name handler
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Router constructs the auto-name source/validator/handler at internal\api\router.go:2129-2144 and supplies it to AI routing at line 5082. Final route registration and AI source adapter were not inspected.
dataSources.trust: Feature-gated, propose-only; stream is cancelled on unmount/scope changes; rejected or blank drafts cannot be applied.
dataSources.dataBehavior: Apply copies a proposed name into page-local state only. No persistence action is visible in this page.
dataSources.endpointVerification: List route verified; AI consumer URL and handler wiring inspected, final AI route registration unverified.

dataSources.name: Workspace and display preferences
dataSources.hook: useSelectedVehicle, useRangeState, useUrlNumber, useUrlString, useUnits, useNumberFormatting
dataSources.owner: Existing workspace, URL-state and formatting owners
dataSources.dataBehavior: Vehicle and exclusive instant bounds scope requests; page and q remain URL-backed; date change resets page; /locations is range-enabled in workspaceScope.ts:48.
dataSources.evidenceLimits: Implementation of range, selection, URL-state and unit hooks was not re-audited.

components.name: PageLayout / LayoutCard
components.role: Full-width shared orchestrator and persistent detail/chart panels; delegates shell/freshness to PageContainer.

components.name: MapsOperationalBrief / OperationalBrief
components.role: Six source-backed metrics, loaded-page scope, receipt time, provenance and retained/partial/unavailable status via useOperationalMetrics.

components.name: LocationLeaderboardPanel
components.role: One domain renderer reused for visits and time; skeleton/error/reset-range empty states; EmbeddedChart with accessible data columns.

components.name: SearchInput / FilterBar / ActiveFilterChips
components.role: Debounced controlled search, scoped recent searches, filter clear affordances.

components.name: GlassPanel / Text / Button / Pagination
components.role: Ranked list rows, semantics, inspect action and pagination. Individual primitive implementations not re-audited.

components.name: EntityPreviewDrawer
components.role: Four evidence fields, six related navigation actions, canonical Drawer and close control.

components.name: AIAutoNameUnnamedLocations
components.role: Optional naming proposal on unnamed/Unknown/coordinate-only locations, review and local apply.

components.name: Skeleton / QueryError / EmptyState / FadeIn
components.role: Section-owned initial/error/empty feedback and three entrance wrappers; reduced-motion implementation not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Both horizontal leaderboards already reuse LocationLeaderboardPanel; no competing chart renderer is needed.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Preserve this domain owner and use the existing chart frame/palette APIs for any extension.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Per-row total/average/last-visit evidence is also presented in the drawer. This is useful progressive disclosure, not grounds to delete either surface.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep both representations and their shared duration/date policies; a local pure evidence adapter is optional if equivalence is proven.

sourceEvidence.detail: Charts stack until xl; list/skeletons use one column until 2xl; search is full width then sm:w-72.
Footer stacks; evidence/actions change to two columns at sm.

issues.detail: A non-wrapping flex row simultaneously reserves rank width, count chip and inspect button. Long address/metadata has little room at 320px despite min-w-0 and break-words; charts also reserve a 112px Y axis plus margins.
issues.fix: Test allocated container widths and long/RTL addresses at all contract widths; allow row controls/metadata to reflow without removing evidence or the inspect action.

sourceStrengths.detail: Semantic ul/li list; inspect has localized entity-specific name and decorative Eye icon hidden.
EmbeddedChart receives title, ariaLabel, data and dataColumns for shared accessible fallback.
Shared search guarantees an accessible name using ariaLabel, placeholder or translated Search.
Evidence is a dl/dt/dd structure; related context uses a labelled nav and native Link elements.

issues.detail: Chart names are truncated before being supplied to accessible fallback rows. The full-address list mitigates loss, but identical 22-character prefixes cannot be distinguished in the chart/table itself.
issues.fix: Retain full source labels in chart data/table/tooltips and truncate only the visual axis tick. Extend the domain panel datum with a separate display label if needed.

issues.detail: Inspect button explicitly has h-9 w-9 (36px), below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. Actual spacing exception/target overlap has not been measured.
issues.fix: Use a 44px mobile target through Button sizing while preserving desktop density; verify focus and target separation.

issues.detail: PageLayout receives query but no loading/busy/error props. PageContainer:135 uses those props, not query, for useLoadAnnouncement; this page does not wire its section loading transition into that shared announcement.
issues.fix: Verify mounted announcements; use the shared non-blocking busy/announcement contract without gating all page sections behind page-level loading/error.

states.initialLoading: Six list skeletons, chart skeletons and brief loading; panels persist.
states.initialFailure: Fatal DataState error produces section QueryError with refetch; summary uses unavailable data and retry.
states.empty: Successful [] gives list explanation plus View drives; each chart provides Reset date range.
states.searchEmpty: Clear search CTA; summary/charts intentionally remain based on unfiltered loaded page.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: FatalError remains null with retained payload; list/charts stay visible; brief marks retained and page delegates query source notice/freshness.
states.offline: Brief checks isRefreshBlocked; current browser/offline notices are unverified.
states.ai: Feature gate, streaming/paused busy handling, proposal validation, local apply and cleanup inspected; no AI request executed.

issues.detail: Disabled query with no selected vehicle has no data but isLoading is false; the detail/chart branches can claim no recorded locations rather than selection-required/unknown. No request has established emptiness.
issues.fix: Render an explicit select-vehicle/unavailable state while retaining all section shells; do not label an unrequested source as empty.

issues.detail: deriveDataState is not told when [] is authoritatively empty; hasData is true for [], so MapsOperationalBrief reports Source data available even when the list is empty. This is resolved availability but does not communicate the shared unavailable/empty distinction.
issues.fix: Use explicit unavailable for a successful empty source and a deliberate empty-summary label while preserving genuine successful zero totals.

issues.detail: previewLocation is a retained object independent of selected vehicle/range/page. Scope changes do not close/rebind it, yet related links use the current vehicle/range, potentially combining old location evidence with new scope.
issues.fix: Bind preview and applied draft to source identity or close/revalidate them when vehicle/range changes; retain intentional open-state behavior only with explicit source scope.

visualIssues.detail: Hardcoded emerald #10b981 and purple #a855f7 chart fills bypass the existing palette/semantic theme contract; purple is a saturated decorative comparison hue. Rank podiums, chart icons and repeated count chips add cyan/amber emphasis across every list row.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained chart palette tokens and neutral row metadata; retain ranking/count semantics and persisted explicit theme choices without resets.

visualIssues.detail: Tooltip cursor uses literal translucent white instead of a surface-hover token; low intensity but fixed to white irrespective of theme.
visualIssues.fix: Consume the canonical chart hover/surface token rather than another page-specific color.

architectureIssues.detail: timeChartData applies unary + to fmtNumber(seconds/3600), a locale/precision formatted string. Decimal-comma or grouped output can become NaN; LocationLeaderboardPanel:78 silently maps non-finite values to zero. Precision preferences also alter plotted measurements rather than only their labels.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the raw numeric display derivation seconds/3600 in chart data; apply locale/precision formatting only in ticks/tooltips/table cells. Invalid measurements must remain unknown, not zero.

architectureIssues.detail: Page owns request construction instead of a typed domain data hook, and queryFn ignores TanStack Query's AbortSignal.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract to the existing locations API-hook owner after inspection; forward signal to request while preserving exact key, enablement, URL parameters and inherited policies.

architectureIssues.detail: Comments and AI UI describe an Apply-to-form/save handoff, but onApplyName only stores appliedName and displays Suggested name ready to save. This page has no canonical rename/geofence form or save action.
architectureIssues.fix: Trace the existing canonical form/navigation owner before implementation and provide a real review handoff if available; otherwise accurately label local draft behavior. Never add an invented endpoint or allow AI to persist automatically.

architectureIssues.detail: Time leaderboard sorts only the visit-ranked loaded page; generic Top locations titles do not independently explain this restriction. Search is also loaded-page-only; rank badges restart at #1 for every page/filter and pagination uses a speculative next-row total.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep all existing loaded-page calculations and next-page behavior but disclose page-local ranking/search scope at the chart/list. Full-range time leaders or server search require an explicit backend contract change, not invented client totals.

priority.rationale: Locale-dependent false-zero time bars, stale preview scope and unrequested-source emptiness affect data trust before visual modernization.
order: Mobile target/reflow and full chart labels
Restrained palette and typed cancellable hook

requiredSharedChanges.name: Typed visited-location query contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: vehicleId nullable; page/pageSize; from and exclusive to; typed SI response; query signal forwarding; preserve inherited retry/cache and exact key; disabled/initial/empty/retained/fatal states.
requiredSharedChanges.reason: Extend an existing domain owner only after inspection; no competing query system.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical AI proposal-to-form handoff
requiredSharedChanges.existingOwnerFile: Explicit missing confirmed owner: canonical location rename/geofence review form was not identified in this bounded trace
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Synthetic location ID, current label and proposed name, source vehicle/window identity, validated draft status, explicit user review/save/cancel; no automatic write.
requiredSharedChanges.reason: Current UI promises a form handoff it does not visibly implement; requires integration ownership, not an audit source edit.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing shared presentation contracts to consume, not replace
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Chart palette tokens; Button 44px mobile target; PageLayout dataSources/query and non-blocking announcement; EntityPreviewDrawer fields/actions; OperationalBrief retained/unavailable states; EmbeddedChart data/dataColumns with full labels.
requiredSharedChanges.reason: No new shared renderer, palette engine, overlay or status registry justified by this one-page evidence. Shared implementation changes require designated owners and independent consumer evidence.

competingImplementations.detail: Inline query construction competes with the established API-hook layer; exact existing domain hook equivalence unverified.
Local fixed chart palette competes with shared palette tokens.
Canonical EmbeddedChart already used; no competing chart frame detected in inspected dependencies.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact root page file bytes only
actions: Address search, scoped recent-search history and clear chips
Related vehicle, drives, charging, alerts, maintenance and signals navigation
Feature-gated AI suggest-name draft and validated local apply
dataBehavior: Preserve real historical drive-derived location groups, geofence-label precedence and synthetic IDs.
Preserve paired [from,to) backend filtering on drive end time, selection enablement and query keys.
Keep wire/cache total_duration_s in seconds; never introduce legacy unit fields or display conversions into raw cached data.
Keep loaded-page metrics, city final-address-segment heuristic with unnamed exclusion and unfiltered summaries.
Preserve visit ordering; sort a copy for time so list ranks and summary do not mutate.
Preserve successful true zeros separately from missing/unrequested/invalid source measurements.
Keep retained rows on refresh failure, independent section states and receipt provenance.
Do not invent coordinates, map capability, saved rename action, full-result export or full-range aggregates.
AI remains propose-only; no production mutation or test request occurred.

evidenceLimits.visual: unverified; visual findings are class/token source evidence, not screenshots
evidenceLimits.backendExecution: unverified; handler/repository source inspected, no database or HTTP request executed
